SERVICES_LIST.NAME: Fire Detection Systems
SERVICES_LIST.DESCRIPTION: Design and implementation of fire detection systems in compliance with national and international standards (NFPA). We integrate advanced technologies for early detection of smoke, heat, and flame, enabling rapid response to minimize operational risks, asset loss, and downtime.
HIGHLIGHTS: Early detection of smoke, heat, and flame
Integration with alarm and monitoring systems

SERVICES_LIST.NAME: Fire Suppression Systems
SERVICES_LIST.DESCRIPTION: Development and installation of fire suppression systems designed to effectively control and extinguish fires. We work with sprinkler systems, clean agents, and specialized solutions tailored to the specific risk profile and operational needs of each facility.
HIGHLIGHTS: Clean agent solutions for critical areas
Custom design based on risk assessment

SERVICES_LIST.DESCRIPTION: Execution of safe and efficient electrical installations in medium and low voltage, fully compliant with technical and regulatory standards. We optimize power distribution to ensure operational continuity, safety, and energy efficiency across all types of projects.

An alarm system was also installed in the transfer area, sprinklers in the pump room, and spot detection in the office area.

ARTICLES_LIST.TITLE: Solicmex obtains NFPA certification: commitment to fire safety
ARTICLES_LIST.DESCRIPTION:
At Solicmex, we reaffirm our commitment to safety and excellence by announcing that we have obtained certification under the standards of the NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), one of the most recognized organizations worldwide in the field of fire protection.

This certification supports the quality of our processes in engineering, installation, maintenance and repair of fire protection systems, ensuring that every project we develop complies with international regulations and high safety standards.

The NFPA is a global reference in the creation of codes and standards designed to minimize the risks and effects of fire. Having this certification not only validates our technical experience, but also provides greater confidence to our clients in every service we offer.

At Solicmex, we understand that fire protection is not just a need, but a responsibility. For this reason, we continue investing in training, certifications and continuous improvement to offer safe, reliable and high-quality solutions.

This achievement represents a step forward in our growth as a specialized company in fire protection systems, consolidating us as a reliable option in the sector.

ARTICLES_LIST.TITLE: Solicmex Implements a Hybrid Fire Protection System
ARTICLES_LIST.DESCRIPTION:
Grupo Solicmex integrates fixed coverage systems with dynamic solutions to achieve greater reach, immediate response, and reduced operational risks.

This hybrid approach enables real-time response in critical areas, optimizing safety without increasing infrastructure.

  • Total coverage
  • Immediate response
  • Reduced risk exposure
